name: ai-security-code-scan
description: Test phase: scan the code you write for security issues — an ensemble of free scanners (semgrep, CodeQL, trivy, osv-scanner, zizmor) run blind and in parallel with an open-ended model-driven review, triaged into one ranked report (SARIF + markdown); plus CodeQL CI setup and reading CodeQL results back. Tool-agnostic.
